title: Env Schema Compiler
description: Compiles a typed, validated env variable schema. Enforces: every key has a unique name and declared type, defaults conform to declared types, secrets have no literal defaults, and all downstream env refs are declared.

error_codes.ES001: env-schema-spec.json missing or invalid — required: envKeys[], unknownKeyPolicy
error_codes.ES003: Env key has invalid or missing type
error_codes.ES004: Default value does not conform to declared type
error_codes.ES005: Secret-marked key has a literal default or committed value
